verdicts.quote: Deploying the project to the named dev org makes a Lightning tab labelled Grok Bot, inside a Lightning app labelled Grok Bot, available.
The Apex entry point runs `with sharing`, touches no standard or custom object other than reading its own configuration
therefore needs no object/field access; sharing, object permission and field permission are separate and none applies to chat content because none is stored (PD-3).

Access is granted by permission sets: Grok Bot User (opens the app/tab, runs the Apex entry point...) and Grok Bot Admin (everything in User plus editing the bot's configuration, R-8). Nothing is granted to any profile by default.
The bot stores no transcript anywhere (no records, files, cache or browser storage)... admins can rely on no in-org copy existing.
Each message uses one callout, no DML and no SOQL (custom-metadata reads only).
verdicts.missing: The design is a synchronous callout (AD-4 open); the callout-after-DML/trigger constraint is not stated and no asynchronous (Queueable/future) design is chosen.

verdicts.quote: The key is not in source, metadata files, custom metadata, custom settings, records, debug logs, the UI, browser memory or test fixtures.
timeout default 60 s, allowed range 1–120 s (R-8; 120 s is the documented maximum for one callout/continuation, to be re-verified
verdicts.missing: Callouts-per-transaction, heap and CPU time limits are not named with numbers; concurrency limit left unresolved.

verdicts.quote: Apex tests with `HttpCalloutMock`/`Test.setMock`; the configuration reader is injectable so tests set values; LWC Jest tests mock the Apex import. No test calls xAI.
a Named Credential for host `https://api.x.ai`... No Remote Site Setting is needed for a Named Credential callout.
page calls the Apex entry point with message + prior successful turns (sync from the user's view; async promise in the page)
verdicts.missing: The reply is assumed to return inline from a synchronous callout; AD-4 (Continuation vs sync) is open and no event/polling mechanism is chosen for long replies.

verdicts.quote: a second send (double click, Enter held down) makes no second callout. If the user clicks New chat while a request is outstanding... the late reply or error is discarded
Unresolved (G-4): Salesforce's cap on concurrent long-running requests (search results disagree...)
verdicts.missing: The concurrency limit value and what the user sees when a request is refused because the limit is reached.

verdicts.quote: REQUEST_REJECTED | other xAI HTTP 4xx ... UPSTREAM_ERROR | xAI HTTP 5xx | `Grok is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.` TIMEOUT | ... `Grok took too long to respond. Try again.`
RATE_LIMITED | xAI HTTP 429 | `Grok is busy or a usage limit was reached. Try again shortly.` ... No automatic retry
any failure shows an error entry, per R-5, never an empty or partial assistant message.
verdicts.missing: What is shown when a reply is truncated by the max output token limit (incomplete response with text); only never-arrives (TIMEOUT) and unreadable bodies are decided.

verdicts.quote: Conversation history lives only in the open page and is lost on reload.
verdicts.missing: No stored record shape; model identifier, timestamps, status and token/usage counts per turn are not recorded anywhere.

verdicts.quote: The bot stores no transcript anywhere (no records, files, cache or browser storage)... Closing/reloading the page, or New chat, ends the transcript.
The only content sent to xAI is the system instruction, the user's typed messages and prior bot replies... No Salesforce record data, user name, email or org identifiers are added.
At most 10 prior turn pairs (20 messages) are sent (default; configurable, R-8). Older messages are omitted from the request but stay visible in the transcript.
an empty (after trim) message is rejected... length 4,000 is accepted; 4,001 is rejected.
An administrator changes them in Setup without a deploy; the next message uses the new values.
verdicts.missing: No kill switch to turn the bot off; failed requests are only in the Apex debug log by reference id (NFR-8), with no admin view.

verdicts.quote: Failures are traceable by the reference id shown to the user and written (with category, HTTP status and elapsed ms, never content) to the Apex debug log.
verdicts.missing: No audit record of who asked what and what was answered, and no stated audit retention.

verdicts.quote: Deployment targets only the org the user names (G-1). Deploy is metadata only... a failed deploy is confirmed by the CLI terminal status... (`sf project deploy validate` dry-run)
verdicts.missing: How configuration/credential differ per environment and the production code-coverage requirement are not stated.

verdicts.quote: The user's message and the indicator appear before the server call returns... A request that does not finish within the configured timeout (default 60 s, max 120 s) ends in TIMEOUT (R-5).
designed empty state (greeting + example prompts), loading state (indicator, Send disabled), error state (R-5 entry with Retry)
Before/after invariants: a user message leaves no record anywhere in the org (before = after for all org data)
